title: I built a mobile idle loot RPG with AI (Claude + ChatGPT + Codex) while working full time. Playtest is open this weekend
author: Ruskarr
selftext:
Hey r/aigamedev 👋

I'm Mewi, a solo dev with a full-time day job. For the last couple of months I've been building **Hero's Haul**, an idle loot-bag RPG for Android and browser, almost entirely with AI tools.

**How it's made**
- **Engine:** Godot 4.7
- **Code + balancing:** Claude does most of the design, code and balance sims. Codex handles side tasks. I direct, test and make the calls.
- **Art:** gear, characters, backdrops, icons and UI are generated with ChatGPT, then cut, fitted and checked by scripts Claude wrote. AI art is great until a helmet ends up floating off someone's head, so a lot of the work is QA.
- **Me:** the vision, the taste, and saying "no, that looks wrong" a few hundred times.

**The game**
Open loot bags, gear up across Knights, Hunters and Mages, push through zones and bosses, and build out pets, skills and talents. It also has clans, clan bosses and an arena.

**Playtest (free)**
- ▶️ Browser: https://mewiau.itch.io/heros-haul (password: `haul2026`)
- 📱 Android APK and patch notes are in the Discord
- 💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/vwZdh5Z5S5 (use /bug, /feedback, /suggest)

Heads up: progression is sped up for testing, nothing carries over to launch, and online features are simulated on your device for now.

I'd love blunt feedback, especially on what feels off or "AI-made" in a bad way. Happy to answer questions about the workflow too.
